timeline.text: One TV, a houseful of kids — and one finished child used to unlock it for everybody.
The ones who hadn't touched their own schoolwork still got to watch, every time.
I built a strict mode, in a Cloudflare Worker, that checks who's actually caught up.
Now it locks the screen, and the admin panel names exactly who still owes work.
One finished child used to be enough. Now it has to be every single one.
